items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 124:1
items.html: The three worlds BYA were clarified from the vessels and sparks that are from the Chazeh [chest] of the seven kings of Nekudim that were broken, and downward. And the ZON of Atzilut were clarified from the vessels that are from the Chazeh of the seven kings and upward, as is known. Therefore the completion of their clarification is that they will return and join with the ZON of Atzilut, which are the vessels from their Chazeh and upward. Therefore Yetzirah, which is the posterior of ZA, must ascend to the place of the ZA of Atzilut of smallness, which clothes from the Tabur of AA and downward. For then ZA must clothe AA, and from the Chazeh of ZA and downward will be the aspect of from the Chazeh of AA and downward, and then Beriah ascends to the two lower thirds of the Tifferet, from the Chazeh to the end of the Tifferet; and Yetzirah ascends to its NHY, and Assiyah to the place of the female. It is found that the YESHSUT and ZON of the present, in the weekday, which stand in the place of the posterior vessels of AA, are the place of the three worlds BYA. And this is the secret that ZA must be AA, and BYA as the posterior of AA, which is the place of the YESHSUT and ZON of the present. (Items 81 and 82).
